title: fastest goal records.
question: Who scored the fastest goal in Europe's top leagues?

items.name: Michel Rio
items.fact: Still the Ligue 1 record; Mbappé came closest in 2022 with 8.3 seconds.

items.name: Shane Long
items.fact: Broke Ledley King's Premier League record of 9.9 seconds from 2000.

items.name: Joseba Llorente
items.fact: The fastest goal ever scored in La Liga.

items.name: Robin Fellhauer
items.fact: Pounced on a Manuel Neuer error; the game ended 2–2.

items.name: Rafael Leão
items.sub: AC Milan vs Sassuolo · Serie A, 2020–21
items.fact: Scored on 20 December 2020; Milan won the game 2–1.

ending: The fastest goal on the whole list came in Scottish junior football: Gavin Stokes, 2.1 seconds.

source.title: Wikipedia: Fastest goals in association football
